verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents a Batch Processing API for high-volume processing and asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios, so bulk customer ingestion is a first-party capability. However, the evidence never shows how to track batch import progress or status, and never shows how to resume after a partial failure. Exports, export types and webhook idempotency keys cover outbound data or webhook delivery rather than import tracking, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented batch job status/progress tracking, per-record error reporting, resume/retry semantics after partial failure, bulk transaction import, and independent corroboration.
